requirements.title: Document three mesh-CA.crt population scenarios
requirements.one_line_summary: Document the three scenarios that determine what goes into mesh-CA.crt: default (installer-generated CA), enterprise CA via ca_tls_cert+ca_tls_key, and pre-signed receptor certs via receptor_tls_cert+custom_ca_cert.

requirements.title: Clarify distinction between custom_ca_cert and ca_tls_cert variables
requirements.one_line_summary: Clearly distinguish custom_ca_cert (system-level trust via update-ca-trust) from ca_tls_cert+ca_tls_key (used by installer to sign receptor node certificates and becomes mesh CA).

requirements.title: Document behavior change: custom_ca_cert no longer added to mesh-CA.crt by default
requirements.one_line_summary: The containerized installer no longer bundles custom_ca_cert into mesh-CA.crt by default; it is only included when receptor_tls_cert is also provided (Scenario 3).

requirements.title: Document new preflight validation for receptor_tls_cert without ca_tls_cert
requirements.one_line_summary: Document the new installer preflight check that requires custom_ca_cert when receptor_tls_cert is provided without ca_tls_cert, including the error message users will see.

requirements.title: Add recommended guidance for custom receptor certificate approaches
requirements.one_line_summary: Add guidance recommending customers create an AAP-specific child/intermediate CA (Scenario 2) as the preferred approach, with pre-signed receptor certs (Scenario 3) as the advanced alternative.

requirements.title: Add warning about large CA bundles in mesh-CA.crt
requirements.one_line_summary: Add a warning that receptor mesh has a practical size limit on mesh-CA.crt and large enterprise CA bundles can cause CRYPTO_BUFFER_EXCEEDED errors breaking receptor connectivity.
